overrides.reason: SF2216 establishes a common-interest-community ombudsperson and register, requires complaint/inquiry analysis, and authorizes assistance to unit owners enforcing their rights. That directly implements stronger HOA/CIC consumer protection and oversight.

HF2432 requires state agencies to refer qualifying suspected fraud, permits lower-dollar referrals, adds a BCA Financial Crimes and Fraud Section, and requires fraud reporting. That directly matches stricter state-agency fraud reporting and additional fraud-prevention tools.

HF2432 creates dedicated state-program fraud investigative capacity, mandatory state-agency referral rules, and annual fraud reporting. Those are direct fraud-oversight and accountability controls matching Robbins's stated position.

SF1959 appropriates more than $10 million per year for maintenance of Military Affairs training facilities and amends State Armory Building Commission powers. That directly provides building/facility resources for the Minnesota National Guard.

HF2563 appropriates Legacy funds for conservation programs including land acquisition, wetland/prairie/wildlife-habitat restoration and enhancement, and grants to conservation organizations. That directly aligns with strengthening conservation programs and protecting Minnesota's environment.

HF2438 names and defines the Empowering Small Minnesota Communities Program, specifies assistance to small communities, and appropriates $2.5 million in each fiscal year to the program. That directly matches Koegel's support for establishing and supporting the program.
